<!-- researcher-schema-start -->
## Researcher starting point

The shared contract was adopted in [PR #44](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/pull/44). Use the same pinned revision below for consistent fields and types.

- [Start here: researcher workflow](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/a222013c1f0106159132564d05e5d24666ad6342/docs/RESEARCH_WORKFLOW.md)
- [Canonical schemas and component registry](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/tree/a222013c1f0106159132564d05e5d24666ad6342/contracts/v1/schemas)
- [Find the kinds covered by your issue](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/a222013c1f0106159132564d05e5d24666ad6342/docs/CONTRACT_MAPPING.md)
- [Research note template](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/a222013c1f0106159132564d05e5d24666ad6342/templates/research-note.md)

Use canonical kinds and fields. Keep incomplete facts in research notes; never invent values to satisfy a schema. Examples are synthetic. Submit proposed schema changes through #40.
<!-- researcher-schema-end -->

Research for **Pick Your AI**, a PCPartPicker-inspired AI system builder. Repository: https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research

**Structure:** seven workstream parents (T0–T6) with native sub-issues for each component. T3 Knowledge & Retrieval, T4 Agents & Integrations, and T5 Training & Fine-Tuning are optional capabilities.

**Fields**
- **Status:** Backlog · Ready · In Progress · In Review (draft decision record open) · Blocked · Done (merged and acceptance criteria met). Set from evidence only.
- **Priority:** research sequencing, not product importance. Critical is the foundation core path; High is core and consumes Critical outputs; Medium is optional capabilities and operational depth; Low is nice-to-have.
- **Tier:** T0–T6 (option labels include the tier name).
- **Readiness:** Ready · Needs input · Blocked · Awaiting decision.
- **Ownership:** GitHub Assignees (source of truth).
- **Work Type:** Epic · Research · Specification · Dataset · Validation.
- **Research Confidence:** Unverified · Low · Medium · High.
- **Dependency Status:** Unblocked · Waiting · Blocked (mirrors native "blocked by" relationships; Readiness records broader readiness).

**Views:** Workstream overview (hierarchy) · Research backlog by priority · Ready to research · Blocked or awaiting decision · Unassigned or missing metadata.

**Dependencies:** native "blocked by" is used only for genuine prerequisites (currently #42 ← #40). Information and compatibility relationships are listed in each issue body and may be cyclic, e.g. model ↔ GPU ↔ inference engine.

Conventions: https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md · Dependency map: https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/main/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md

project_identity.title: Pick Your AI — Market Research & Competitive Intelligence

projects.project_description:
## Mission and boundary
Validate or falsify demand for a dependency-aware AI stack builder. Research evidence lives in Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research. Technical component decisions remain in [Research Project #1](https://github.com/orgs/Pick-Your-AI/projects/1); preserve its live owners. This project coordinates market evidence, not implementation.

## Method and evidence
Record primary URL, publisher, access date, version/region, claim type, confidence and limitations. Marketing is a vendor claim, not an independent measurement. Unknown capability is not unsupported capability. No fabricated pricing or adoption figures. Data access does not confer redistribution rights. Findings become candidate requirements only after evidence review and consumer-owner acceptance.

## Workstreams
MR-01 landscape; MR-02 feature matrix; MR-03 deep dives; MR-04 PCPartPicker experience; MR-05 customers; MR-06 market demand; MR-07 monetization; MR-08 data rights/integrations; MR-09 feasibility; MR-10 differentiation; MR-11 MVP; MR-12 quality and handoffs.

## Workflow
Inbox = new; Triage = missing qualification; Ready = scoped, assigned, startable; In Progress = active work; In Review = relevant PR open; Blocked = genuine execution prerequisite; Done = merged evidence, criteria met and handoff accepted. No automatic closure-to-acceptance assumption. Review state manually when PRs change; no workflow automation has been configured.

## Priority and readiness
P0 foundation; P1 core decision; P2 supporting; P3 exploratory. Weight strategic value 25%, downstream impact 20%, user relevance 20%, evidence availability 15%, feasibility 10%, urgency/change risk 10%; score each 1–5. Unknown inputs remain null. Record qualitative overrides. P0 is not vendor quality. Research Readiness: Ready, Needs Input, Blocked, Awaiting Decision. Effort stays Unknown absent an owner estimate.

## Ownership and triage
Assignees are authoritative. CompleteDotTech coordinates market work; preserve T0 tynamite and the other live technical owners. Deduplicate against issues, PRs and research notes before creation. One outcome per research issue; native subissues for separately reviewed outcomes; checklists for steps. Native blockers only for genuine prerequisites, never compatibility cycles.

## Phased execution limits
A: one current audit before mutations. B: one dedicated project, nine requested fields, twelve functional views. C: initial 30–40 distinct candidates, 10–15 desk profiles; unavailable sites remain unverified. D/E: one program, twelve workstreams, at most eight independently justified validation subissues in the initial pass. F: one reviewable evidence PR; no paid API calls, deployments, mass scraping, or customer outreach in this pass. G: read back all changes and run repository checks. Expand only for material evidence gaps; record expansion reasons. These limits control breadth, not permission to omit verification. No invented deadlines or estimates.

## Completion and handoffs
Drafts are not Done. Link the consuming technical issue, exact evidence, requested decision and owner response. Refs rather than Closes while acceptance is pending. #40 owns contracts, #41 evidence/freshness, #39 cost semantics. PR #44 (v1 contract adoption) merged; its frozen contracts must not be modified by market research. Native blockers: #57 and #58 are blocked by #66 (direct-substitute test); all other relationships are information or validation inputs.


## Initial evidence and execution
[Program #47](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/issues/47) · [Review PR #67](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/pull/67) · [Evidence guide](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/research/market-intelligence/docs/market-research/README.md). Initial desk findings are In Review; independent measurements and customer validation are not completed. The six existing specialist collaborators have Project writer access; repository permissions are unchanged.

Triage view includes Inbox, Triage and unset status. GitHub cannot OR different fields: manually route incomplete or unassigned items to Triage during intake and audit missing metadata. Research Roadmap uses a workstream table, without invented dates.

## CanIRun.ai intake (2026-10-16)

[CanIRun.ai devices](https://www.canirun.ai/devices) added for review in [PR #98](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/pull/98), tracked through #48/#49/#50/#66. Proposed inventory: 33 entities, 14 profiles, 1,584 matrix cells. Directory evidence only; scenario execution, rights and owner acceptance pending. No new issue or Project-field change. [Profile](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/research/canirun-intake/research/market/competitors/canirun-ai.md).

comparison.view_configuration: The twelve historical views are retained in the initial configuration artifact. This REST capture does not reread layouts, filters or permissions and does not claim they were changed.

limitations: These public GETs used no credentials or cookies and performed no Project mutation. They do not prove when or by whom visibility changed.
Separate field, item, Project-description and relationship reads are not one transaction. Original timestamps and any intervening changes are retained.

The compact projection retains all returned field definitions/options and item identity/select/native metadata needed for this audit; large repeated issue bodies, account/repository objects and parent/linked-PR bodies remain represented by their exact raw-response hashes.

Every Project response returned fewer than 100 records and no Link header. The connector relationship batch returned fewer than 100 entries per endpoint; it exposed no per-request HTTP headers, so none are asserted.
Repository source, statistical/experimental evidence, source rights, consumer acceptance and Project metadata are separate. Valid option identity or a Done value is not proof of completed research.
The initial backlog owner is a historical planning field. Live GitHub co-assignees remain authoritative; no assignment is replaced by this comparison.
